✨ WHAT'S NEW IN THIS VERSION?

🎥 Fully Adjustable Drift Camera

Customize the distance, height, steering smoothness, dynamic field of view, drift blur intensity, and even camera shake. Feel every corner like you're in a racing movie. Improve your drifting.

⚙️ Intelligent Air Suspension

Activate or deactivate it with a single click. Choose from quick profiles: NORMAL, SEMI-LOW, LOW, LOWERED, or OFF-ROAD. Adjust the smoothness of the transition and see how your car reacts instantly.

⚡ Power Multiplier (1x to 60x)

Accelerate to the max. Feel pure power with every press of the accelerator.

🛑 Improved Braking (1% to 20%)

Adjusts deceleration for precise corner entry or instant stops.

🔐 Key System

The key system has been redesigned to maximize access.

🌟 Redesigned Rayfield Interface

For improved RC performance.

🎮 Quick Access with Key & Key

Currently not compatible with phones.
